endpoint: Distribution of physical injury/condition mentions across regular-season player-game public injury/practice report listings. One physical listing contributes one unit, split equally among distinct categories across all four fields. Not new clinical injuries, diagnosis-specific rates, or AGL.
sourceSnapshotNote: Uses existing frozen source snapshots; no partial 2026 observations included.

primary.simultaneous_interval: Centered maximum standardized deviation across all 11 categories; approximate familywise 95% intervals

adjustment: Other-team category proportions are computed within season × listed-position strata, then weighted to the distribution of SF physical-report listings across those strata. This standardizes the MIX conditional on being listed; it does not adjust injury incidence by roster exposure.
inferenceCaveat: Approximate conditional resampling inference: SF player trajectories are resampled across all their observed seasons; non-SF franchises are resampled across all years. This preserves repeated weekly listings and reference-franchise dependence, but does not represent independent replications of the SF organization or fully cover shared calendar/player-movement dependence. SF and time window were selected after observing its history. Global bootstrap p is exploratory, not confirmatory or causal. No naive row-independent chi-square p-values are used.

displayNotes.counts: Fractional player-game report-listing weight, not unique injury count
displayNotes.defaultIntervals: Approximate simultaneous 95% intervals across all 11 categories
displayNotes.intervalAvailability: Full-era SF comparison only; other selections are descriptive
displayNotes.comparison: Other 31 teams standardized to selected team’s listed-position/season composition
displayNotes.locationNotPathology: Body-region / condition reports do not establish ACL tears or Achilles ruptures
